title: Palace: Gov’t saves P260M on Asean Summit vehicles

blocks.text: The government saved an estimated P260.4 million in transportation costs for the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and Related Summits through vehicles and logistical support provided by three private companies, Malacañang said Saturday. Presidential Communications Office Undersecretary Claire Castro said Hyundai Motor Philippines, Lexus Philippines through Toyota Motor Philippines, and Grab Philippines
